articles.title: Netflix’s coziest show has made a very quiet return
articles.essence: The bigger Netflix gets, the easier it is to miss stuff. This is true of all digital platforms, of course, but it's especially true of Netflix of late, as the streaming service's lineup now also includes a growing library of reality shows, live-programming, and even games.

articles.title: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
articles.essence: Independent Android app developers are worried about their privacy after Google announced that from next year many of them will be required to share a phone number and address publicly. The policy change is intended to meet European Union regulations under the Digital Services Act, but Google says contact details will be made public worldwide. […]
